name: ARSHIEL SAFETY
description:
ARSHIEL SAFETY – AI-Powered Enterprise EHS Management Platform

ARSHIEL SAFETY is an intelligent, all-in-one Enterprise Environment, Health & Safety (EHS), HSE and Occupational Safety Management Platform designed to transform workplace safety through digitalization, automation and AI-powered intelligence.

Manage your entire organization's safety operations through one centralized platform — from hazard identification and risk assessment to incident investigation, compliance management and real-time performance monitoring.

**CORE EHS MANAGEMENT FEATURES**

• AI-Powered Safety Intelligence & Risk Insights
• HIRA, HAZID, JSA, JHA & Risk Assessments
• Permit to Work (PTW) & LOTO Management
• Incident, Accident & Near-Miss Management
• Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & CAPA Tracking
• Workplace Safety Inspections & Audits
• Safety Observations & Unsafe Act/Condition Reporting
• Contractor & Workforce Safety Management
• Safety Training, Induction & Toolbox Talks
• Emergency Preparedness & Response Management
• PPE & Safety Equipment Management
• Environmental & Sustainability Management
• Legal Compliance & ISO Management
• Safety Document & Digital Record Management
• Daily, Weekly & Monthly Safety Activity Tracking
• Automated Reports, Analytics & KPI Dashboards

**INTELLIGENT DIGITAL PLATFORM**

• Dynamic Parent & Child Module Builder
• Custom Forms, Checklists & Workflows
• Multi-Level Approval & Authorization
• Role-Based Access Control
• Department, Site & Project Management
• Real-Time Monitoring & Notifications
• Centralized Document Repository
• Configurable Reporting & Analytics
• Multi-Industry & Multi-Site Management

**DESIGNED FOR MULTIPLE INDUSTRIES**

Pharmaceuticals | Semiconductor | FMCG | Manufacturing | IT & Data Centers | Construction | Heavy Industries | Warehousing & Logistics | Infrastructure | Engineering & Corporate Operations.

**OUR VISION**

To create safer workplaces, prevent incidents, simplify EHS compliance and build a proactive safety culture through intelligent technology and continuous improvement.

ARSHIEL™ – EHS AI SOLUTIONS

Smarter Safety. Safer Tomorrow.

One Platform. All Safety Operations. AI-Powered Prevention.
